subject: general
question: In which city was the 141st session of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) inaugurated in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **141st session** of the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** was inaugurated in **Mumbai, India**.
 
• It marked an important occasion as the IOC session was held in India after a gap of **40 years**. The last session in India was held in **New Delhi** in 1983.
 
• **Mumbai** is one of the major metropolitan cities in India and is widely recognized for its infrastructure and global connectivity, making it an ideal host for such significant international events.
 
• India's hosting of this session highlights its increased involvement in **global sports governance** and reflects the country's growing stature in the international sports community.
 
• During the IOC session, key decisions related to the **Olympic Games** and the global sports agenda are discussed, making it a platform of immense importance.
 
• The session in Mumbai was held at the **Jio World Convention Centre**, which is one of the largest and most advanced convention centers in India.
 
• Prominent figures, including **IOC President Thomas Bach**, attended the session, showcasing India's importance in the international sports domain.
 
• India's hosting of this event may also serve as a stepping stone for the country in bidding for hosting future mega sporting events, including the **Olympic Games**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi**__

 __
 
• **Delhi**, the capital city of India, is known for its historical significance and has previously hosted the **IOC session** in 1983.
 
• Although Delhi is a popular choice for international events, the **141st IOC session** was strategically held in Mumbai to showcase other cities of India as capable hosts for global events.
 
 
 
• **Chennai**__
 __
 
• **Chennai**, located in the state of Tamil Nadu, is renowned for its culture and infrastructure.
 
• While Chennai is an important city for sports like **cricket and chess**, it was not chosen for the IOC session due to logistical and strategic reasons favoring Mumbai.
 
 
 
• **Prayagraj**__
 
 
• **Prayagraj**, previously known as Allahabad, is famous for its religious and historical significance.
 
• It is not generally considered a hub for international sporting events due to limited infrastructure compared to cities like Mumbai or Delhi.
